request: 基于现有能力完善目标与验收、项目知识和决策记录，做好测试和文档
acceptance: Extend existing session plan items with explicit deliverables and individually reviewable acceptance criteria; execution completion alone cannot complete a goal with unmet criteria.

Bind operator acceptance to the latest run and durable tool receipts; stale updates/imported reports never inherit accepted status. Preserve legacy plans and dependency behavior for items without criteria.

Extend existing project token-memory storage with source-linked facts, constraints, decisions and questions; separate proposed/confirmed/superseded/archived state, explicit operator confirmation, CAS and conflict visibility.
Make current-project records available across sessions and in bounded model context; preserve legacy memory text, remote-cache behavior and workspace isolation.
Expose both features in the existing task/plan panel with English localization and real desktop/narrow-screen browser acceptance.
Run focused API, persistence, concurrency, context, import/export and UI regressions plus quick/full checks where applicable, and update current user/API/architecture documentation.
scope: Owned feature worktree; internal/server plan, task outcome, project-memory/context/tool integration and existing task-plan UI.

Focused tests, repository verification registration, bilingual current docs and controlled task/evidence. No production restart, paid provider invocation, unrelated files or change to frozen release assets.

requirements.summary: User authorized the first two capability improvements, based on existing functionality, with tests and documentation.

design.summary: Optional contracts extend existing PlanItem and snapshots; structured records extend memoryTokenStore and existing project cache. Operator review/confirmation remains separate from model execution. Legacy text and uncontracted plans are compatible.

implementation.summary: Implemented bounded criteria/review/history, project/run-bound sign-off, approval transitions, dependency gates, existing-memory records with confirmation/replacement/archive/conflicts/CAS, bounded model search/cursors and task-board UI/tool switches. Fixed initial-snapshot redraw #874 and enabled goals in empty sessions.

verification.summary: Actual Chinese/English 1440/390 UI and IAB observation passed, including real synthetic-provider execution, revision/sign-off, conflict replacement/export and unsent-draft retention. Full current-tree regression in progress; no paid provider or production deployment.

documentation.summary: Bilingual usage/API/storage guide, current README/features/user guides, PRD, architecture and handover updated. Source additions are explicitly absent from published RC2 package.

rollback: Back up sessions and the entire project cache before reverting source/older writers. Optional fields read old data; old writers may discard new metadata. No automatic data deletion/migration or production upgrade.
handoff: Finish frozen-tree full verification and source PR integration. No new version tag, Release, marketplace change or production restart for this feature task.
